Subject: Evidence request: audit log granularity, BYOK rotation, retention windows

Hi Camila,

We're doing a compliance review for our upcoming private deployment and need a short evidence pack from Redwood showing:
- Types of audit logs available (request/response, auth events, KV/cache ops) and retention granularity (per-request timestamps, per-token metadata).
- How BYOK/KMS is handled for Private: key rotation, whether CMKs can be exported historically, and evidence of key wrap/unwrapping.
- SSO audit trail: events we can pull and format options (SAML assertions, OIDC logs).
- A sample export (anonymized) and a checklist showing where data residency controls apply.

Target: need this by 2027-04-12 to pass our vendor review. Please point me to who we should work with internally to get the artifacts.

Thanks,
--
Rita Kaur
Director, Compliance
ArcadiaPay

Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: audit log granularity, BYOK rotation, retention windows

Thanks Camila — quick triage from Security.
Summary of what we can deliver now (MVP evidence pack):
- Audit logs: request metadata (timestamp, request id, model id, route, latency), auth events (login, token minting, KMS unwrap attempts). We do NOT retain raw request/response payloads by default in hosted mode; Private customers can opt-in.
- BYOK/KMS: For Redwood Private we integrate with customer-managed KMS. We can show handshake logs, key-id references in audit trail, and the rotation timestamps. We cannot export customer CMKs themselves — only key ID references and wrap/unwrap audit events.
- SSO: We can provide authentication events (SAML/OIDC login, logout, failure codes) with assertion IDs where available.

Open questions we need answered from Product/Infra to finalize pack:
- What retention window does Arcadia require? (30/90/365 days)
- Do they require any queryable index over token-level metadata?
- Residency: which region are they deploying in? (Arcadia earlier said us-west)

If we prioritize this, Security can assemble checklist + sample exports by 2027-04-09. Otherwise, full package with redaction and longer exports is ~2027-04-15.

Attachment: req_checklist.md

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: naomi@redwood.com, camila@redwood.com, marissa@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: audit log granularity, BYOK rotation, retention windows

Notes from Infra perspective: technical constraints and steps to produce exports.
- Private deployment setup: customer provides KMS (CloudKMS / Vault). Our runtime stores only key references and wrap/unwrap events. We cannot export CMKs or private key material — that's by design for BYOK.
- To produce an anonymized audit export we will run a one-off job that pulls from the audit shard for the tenant and writes to an encrypted S3 bucket in their region. Estimated runtime: 3-5 hours for a 30-day window (depends on QPS).
- Command (internal): redwood-audit-export --tenant arcadiapay --start 2027-03-01 --end 2027-03-31 --redact-payloads --out s3://arcadia-evidence/exports/031-2027/
- Storage impact: ~120GB per 30 days (estimate) -> ~0.12 TB, ~ $10/TB/month (rough). Longer retention increases storage & retention policy updates.
- KMS rotation: we log rotation timestamps and wrap/unwrap audit events. If Arcadia needs proof of key material archival, we need explicit contractual language — otherwise we can only show logs.

Attachment: audit_export_manifest.json

I'll stand up the export job once Security signs off on the exact fields to include and Camila confirms timeline.

— Priyom
Platform Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: camila@redwood.com, naomi@redwood.com, priyom@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: audit log granularity, BYOK rotation, retention windows

Product tradeoffs / proposal:
Option A (Fast, conservative) — MVP evidence pack by 2027-04-09
- Include metadata logs (timestamps, request IDs, model id, KMS wrap/unwrap events, SSO auth events).
- Redact request/response payloads and all PII.
- Minimal transformation, deliver as CSV + sample JSON.
- Impact: low eng effort (1 sprint slice), no infra policy changes.

Option B (Full, higher effort) — Full indexed export + 90-day slice by 2027-04-15
- Include masked token-level metadata and query index for the customer.
- Requires retention policy update and storage provisioning.
- Impact: medium eng effort (2–3 sprint slices), infra cost & SRE review.

Ask for Arcadia: pick A or B and confirm retention window (30/90/365). If A, we proceed with Naomi's checklist + Priyom's export command. If B, we will need an approved order for Dedicated capacity/retention add-on.

Attachment: MVP_evidence_plan.docx

Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Security Features
Redwood Inference
